name: Management Solutions Co Ltd
summary: Management Solutions co.,Ltd. delivers a comprehensive array of services, including management advisory, project implementation, and specialized project management education. Their product portfolio features PMO ONLINE, an online platform for project oversight, alongside services for career development. Additionally, they provide tools to improve data visualization and support strategic decision-making, offer hands-on training courses, and develop PROEVER, their proprietary software designed to enhance organizational knowledge exchange. Established in 2005, the company's headquarters are situated in Tokyo, Japan.
